checks.name: CK_BIL_PAY_ORDER_PAY_ORDER_AMO
checks.expression:

    AND ("amt_captd" >= CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)))
    AND ("amt_rfndd" >= CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)))
    AND ((("sd_order_type" = 'REFUND')
    AND ("amt_captd" = CAST(0 AS NUMERIC(1)))
    AND ("amt_rfndd" <= "amt_reqd"))
    OR (("sd_order_type" <> 'REFUND')
    AND ("amt_captd" <= "amt_reqd")
    AND ("amt_rfndd" <= "amt_captd")))
